page.overview:
Who is Pseudo-Dark Sakura?

Disclaimer: The name for the following form is only conjectural - the form's real name is unknown and a placeholder is used instead.

Pseudo-Dark Sakura is a transformation for Sakura Kasugano that only appears in the manga Sakura Ganbaru!, which takes place roughly before the events of Street Fighter Alpha 2 in Volume 1 and during the events of the game in Volume 2. Ever since she first entered this state in her fight with Karin Kanzuki, Sakura is constantly seen in this state throughout the manga, but only for brief periods of time.

Pseudo-Dark Sakura looks very similar to regular Sakura in appearance - however, one of the main changes to Sakura's appearance in this state is that her eyes change from a lively brown to a rather soulless brown. Sakura can also be seen with and without her headband in this state.

Unlike regular Sakura and even the Dark Sakura seen in the games proper, this version of her behaves solely on instinct and her will to defeat her opponent in a fight. As a result of this, she rarely ever speaks to her opponents or watches her surroundings during a fight and keeps her words in her head while focusing on her opponent. When she does speak, however, it's mostly just attack names, battle cries, or short sentences.
